//: The generated HTML is committed, so there is nothing to build here - run `npm run build` locally after editing anything in tools/. The rewrite sends /api/* to Railway so the browser only ever talks to ONE origin: the session cookie stays first-party (SameSite=Lax survives the Stripe redirect) and there is no CORS to configure. Replace the host below with your Railway domain.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://js.stripe.com; frame-src https://js.stripe.com https://hooks.stripe.com https://checkout.stripe.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.stripe.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; form-action 'self' https://checkout.stripe.com; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'
